name: Festival Danau Toba (FDT)
description: An annual tourism and cultural extravaganza celebrating the cultural heritage of the Batak people and the natural majesty of the Lake Toba Geopark. It features traditional sport boat races (Sopo), Tor-Tor dance competitions, fashion shows of Ulos fabric, and music concerts on the lake.

name: Pesta Rondang Bittang
description: A Simalungun Batak festival of gratitude celebrating the harvest under the full moon. It includes traditional Simalungun arts, music, dance performances, and community games.

name: Samosir Music International
description: A major lakeside music festival on Samosir Island that combines local Batak folk music with international musicians, promoting Lake Toba as a global tourism destination through the power of world music.
